text:
incident-bot: ALERT: high 5xx and TPM oscillation on model neptune7b across us-west-2. 5xx rate = 4.8% (baseline 0.2%), TPM burst > 12k sustained for 4m. dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1752505432 :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: seeing it, paging in. taking ownership. can someone grab customer impact?
cs-lina: a couple of support tickets from org: AcmePayments and Verta said timeouts and unexpected errors since ~09:22PT. they see degraded responses and tool-call failures.
sre-rita: looking at logs — KV cache pressure + OOM-ish traces on neptune7b nodes. seems like model inference oscillates under bursty prefix reuse.
infra-hugo: we should throttle at the model layer, not global. propose temporary per-model caps: TPM 30k -> 3k, RPM 3k -> 300. also consider disabling function-calling for that family.
runtime-maya: agree. quick mitigation: reduce TPM/RPM and toggle funcall off for neptune7b. fallback routing to neptune6b for requests with funcall enabled.
pm-jordan: if we route away, need to let customers know about potential quality delta. cs-lina can draft.
oncall-alex: action list: 1) execute quota cut 2) disable funcall on neptune7b 3) enable fallback routing 4) notify affected orgs 5) monitor error/latency for 15m.
infra-hugo: running command now: ```
# temp per-model caps
redwoodctl quota set --model neptune7b --tpm 3000 --rpm 300
# disable funcall
redwoodctl feature toggle --model neptune7b --funcall false
# route funcall traffic to neptune6b
redwoodctl routing set --from-model neptune7b --fallback neptune6b --condition funcall=true
```
sre-rita: commands applied, nodes show reduced qps to neptune7b. tailing errors.
incident-bot: UPDATE: quota change applied by infra-hugo at 1752505580. funcall disabled on neptune7b.
cs-lina: pushed notices to AcmePayments + Verta via support ticket, flagged potential smaller responses if routed to neptune6b. they acknowledged.
pm-jordan: added incident in PagerDuty and created incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/internal/incidents/1752505432-neptune7b-throttle
runtime-maya: metric snapshot after changes: 5xx -> 0.6%, latency p95 down from 2.3s to 1.1s for routed traffic. still watching kv cache warm-up for neptune6b.
oncall-alex: good improvement. keep for 30m and reevaluate. if stable, gradually relax caps and re-enable funcall behind canary at 10% traffic.
sre-rita: one caveat — some tenants use pinning to neptune7b; we'll need to carve policy exceptions or notify them to avoid unexpected failures. listing pinned tenants now.
cs-lina: found 3 pinned tenants: DataOps, AcmePayments, BlueOak. reaching out individually.
infra-hugo: note for postmortem: kernel-level mem fragmentation triggered by repeated short-lived bursts + kv cache thrash. recommend runtime patch to pre-allocate KV and better eviction heuristics.
pm-jordan: assigning follow-ups: @runtime-maya run canary to re-enable funcall, @sre-rita collect logs for postmortem, @infra-hugo propose quota automation for surge shaping, @cs-lina finalize customer comms.
incident-bot: RESOLVE: incident transitioned to mitigated state at 1752506000. monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
